headline: Dublin Author Begins Romance That Will Shape a Literary Masterpiece
dispatch: James Joyce, a young Dublin writer, took his first walk with Nora Barnacle on June 16, 1904, a date he would later immortalize as the single day on which his novel Ulysses unfolds. The book, published in 1922, follows Leopold Bloom through the streets of Dublin on that precise date. The anniversary is now celebrated annually as Bloomsday by readers and literary societies worldwide.
answer: Joyce walks with Nora Barnacle, inspiring Bloomsday, 1904
